# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple TFM and WinUI fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple platform TFM alignment and a WinUI Projection DLL fix.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple library and app TFM alignment backported** — Library targets now use versioned 26.0 TFMs while app targets use the unversioned form, matching the Apple SDK alignment already shipped in v4. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9 fixed** — Consumers using the WinUI projection on .NET 9 no longer encounter a DllNotFoundException when loading the projection assembly. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
